[NGST.4.2] At startup, read the `.dsc` bytes and hand them to
`ds_engine_load_dsc` **before** asserting facts. A load registers the schemas
*and* rules the source declared, and it is the only way a schema reaches the
engine ([NFCT.1.1]).

A load that fails once it has begun reading the artefact spends the engine
([RDSC.9.8]), and [NERR.8.2] lists what it can return and which failures a
corrected artefact answers.
